objective: Test timestep stability of the 1.34-time-unit unique-yield endpoint using genuinely coupled Brownian paths at dt 0.02, 0.01, and 0.005.

inputs.endpoint: 67 steps at dt=0.02 = 1.34 physical time units

fallback_task: Repair only deterministic implementation/provenance defects without inspecting or changing frozen outcomes.
frozen_gate: abs(mean contrast dt0.02 - mean contrast dt0.01) < 1.0 and seed-level sign changes <= 1/8; dt0.005 is mandatory informational evidence.
